result.title: HandRSI: Recursive Self-Improvement for Hand Pose Estimation
result.comment: Technical report. 25 pages, 17 figures, 18 tables. Code: https://github.com/GinKenneth/Hand_RSI
result.summary: Egocentric 3D hand pose estimators still miss hands at the image border, misplace occluded hands and jitter. Such failures are usually fixed by hand-written inference refinements and by fine-tuning, two interdependent steps that are tuned separately. We present HandRSI, a recursive self-improvement framework for a hand pose system that consists of a video estimator and its executable inference harness. In each round, coding agents refine the harness, and a change is accepted only if it improves a composite of all ten benchmark metrics on held-out data without significantly regressing any of them. The accepted harness then guides the estimator through selective distillation, which supervises hand presence and temporal consistency on frames without ground truth, while ground truth supervises pose. Since the updated estimator may change which refinements remain useful, the harness is re-validated on it. Starting from the released ACE-Ego-Hand model, five rounds reduce MPJPE-p by 35% on HOT3D and 11% on ARCTIC and roughly halve jitter. On HOT3D, HandRSI's MPJPE-p is 16% lower than that of ACE-Ego-Hand fine-tuned on the same ground truth. Under a unified protocol, it outperforms nine re-run published methods on all ten metrics of both benchmarks. Hypervolume selection on the accuracy-speed front yields Lite, Medium and Heavy systems running at 20.7 to 41.1 FPS. This report gives the full method, every stage of every round and the complete protocol. Code, evaluator, harnesses and weights are public.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 HandRSI，让编码智能体迭代改写手部姿态估计系统的推理 harness，接受标准是所有十项基准指标在留出数据上整体提升且无显著退化，再用被接受的 harness 通过选择性蒸馏更新估计器，在 HOT3D、ARCTIC 上降低误差与抖动。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 LVR 主线无直接关联，但其在无 GT 帧上监督「手存在性与时序一致性」的选择性蒸馏，以及以多指标不退化作为接受准则的递归自改进，可能为 latent 轨迹的弱监督信号与贡献分配提供可供核查的线索。
